text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's race, the Kikuka Sho, is the longest of the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Long races are Gold Ship's forte, so I'd really like to see her win this, but…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: This is some darn good tea… And the autumn leaves are looking lovely…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The way she's kicking back, you'd think she's here for a leisurely vacation.
choice_data_list: This is no time to relax! The race is about to start!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It's fine. The best way to win a race is to go in loose and relaxed.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'll be there just as soon as I finish my tea, don't you worry. Oh, and by the way…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Can you pass me those rice crackers?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Relaxing might just be her way of getting ready for the race, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Honestly, she's really stressing me out!
